parties.petitioner: Azgar Barid (D) By Lrs. And Others

summary: Challenge to Karnataka High Court's 2009 judgment allowing respondents' appeal and restoring trial court's 1987 decree which granted partial partition; High Court divided properties among legal heirs of Mohiyuddin Pasha including respondents 3-8 while excluding plaintiffs 1-2 due to predeceasing lineage; appellant contested exclusion of non-appealing plaintiffs 4-8 and challenged High Court's framing of legal questions concerning factual determinations; Court upheld partition suit principles under CPC orders allowing relief for non-appealing plaintiffs and confirmed second appeals can examine factual perversity under Section 100 CPC.
legal_provisions_cited: Section 100 of Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
Order 41 Rule 4 of Code of Civil Procedure
Order 41 Rule 33 of Code of Civil Procedure
Bhagwan Swaroop and Others v. Mool Chand and Others
Dr. P. Nalla Thampy Thera v. B.L. Shanker and Others
Chandramohan Ramchandra Patil and Others v. Bapu Koyappa Patil (Dead) Through LRs and Others
Municipal Committee, Hoshiarpur v. Punjab State Electricity Board and Others
final_judgment: Dismissed appeal maintaining High Court judgment requiring partition among specified heirs with shares allocated to plaintiff No.3 (1/8th), defendant No.1 (7/36th), plaintiff No.4 (7/36th), defendant No.8 (7/36th), plaintiff No.5 (7/72nd), plaintiff No.6 (7/72nd), plaintiff No.7 (7/72nd)
